visualVerdict.visibleDelta: The compact upright armature became a coherent asymmetric organism with persistent head/body mass, discrete radial feet, readable sensory anatomy, and plausible unseen-side completion across four views.
visualVerdict.failureTexture: The result remains aesthetically crude and somewhat plantlike; this assay proves scaffold-to-3D survival, not production creature quality.

claimBoundary.supported: At least one newly introduced non-bulbous morphology can be steered through image generation and survive a fast Trellis cast as a coherent 3D organism.

nextPressure: Adjudicate the controlled style-axis matrix, then widen topology within the strongest surviving program family.
